slide1.title: Training Doesn’t Fail From Lack of Content
slide1.body: It fails from lack of application
slide1.prompt: Start here when you want the room to see the difference between static content and applied behavior.
speakerNotes: Training content alone is not the answer.
The system has to help people do the right thing in the moment.
